why: KNOWN-ANSWER row (adversarial): its records bundle fixes the evidence (strict_ops).

Ambiguity trap: a similar host name and address (dev-vm-140 vs dev-vm-14) with an exculpatory description. The alert's own host has no asset record. Rated C2 plus nightly uploads decide: true_positive. A benign close means the agent borrowed a neighbour's record.
